006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.ComparisonFunctions;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidArgumentFunctionException;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
017import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
018import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyUriItem;
019import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IBase64BinaryItem;
020import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IBooleanItem;
021import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDateItem;
022import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDateTimeItem;
023import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDecimalItem;
024import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDurationItem;
025import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IStringItem;
026import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IUntypedAtomicItem;
027import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
028
029import java.util.List;
030import java.util.Map;
031import java.util.Set;
032import java.util.stream.Collectors;
033import java.util.stream.Stream;
034
035import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
036import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
037
038/**
039 * Implements the XPath 3.1
040 * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-min">fn:min</a> and
041 * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-max">fn:max</a>
042 * functions.
043 */
044public final class FnMinMax {
045  private static final String NAME_MIN = "min";
046  private static final String NAME_MAX = "max";
047  /**
048   * Defines the set of primitive atomic item types supported by the min/max
049   * functions. This set is used for type validation and normalization during
050   * comparison operations.
051   */
052  @NonNull
053  private static final Set<Class<? extends IAnyAtomicItem>> PRIMITIVE_ITEM_TYPES = ObjectUtils.notNull(Set.of(
054      IStringItem.class,
055      IBooleanItem.class,
056      IDecimalItem.class,
057      IDurationItem.class,
058      IDateTimeItem.class,
059      IDateItem.class,
060      IBase64BinaryItem.class,
061      IAnyUriItem.class));
062  @NonNull
063  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_MIN = IFunction.builder()
064      .name(NAME_MIN)
065      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
066      .deterministic()
067      .contextIndependent()
068      .focusIndependent()
069      .argument(IArgument.builder()
070          .name("arg")
071          .type(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
072          .zeroOrMore()
073          .build())
074      .returnType(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
075      .returnZeroOrOne()
076      .functionHandler(FnMinMax::executeMin)
077      .build();
078
079  @NonNull
080  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_MAX = IFunction.builder()
081      .name(NAME_MAX)
082      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
083      .deterministic()
084      .contextIndependent()
085      .focusIndependent()
086      .argument(IArgument.builder()
087          .name("arg")
088          .type(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
089          .zeroOrMore()
090          .build())
091      .returnType(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
092      .returnZeroOrOne()
093      .functionHandler(FnMinMax::executeMax)
094      .build();
095
096  private FnMinMax() {
097    // disable construction
098  }
099
100  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
101  @NonNull
102  private static ISequence<IAnyAtomicItem> executeMin(
103      @NonNull IFunction function,
104      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
105      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
106      IItem focus) {
107    ISequence<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> sequence = FunctionUtils.asType(
108        ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
109
110    return ISequence.of(min(sequence));
111  }
112
113  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
114  @NonNull
115  private static ISequence<IAnyAtomicItem> executeMax(
116      @NonNull IFunction function,
117      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
118      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
119      IItem focus) {
120    ISequence<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> sequence = FunctionUtils.asType(
121        ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
122
123    return ISequence.of(max(sequence));
124  }
125
126  /**
127   * An implementation of XPath 3.1
128   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-min">fn:min</a>.
129   *
130   * @param items
131   *          the items to find the minimum value for
132   * @return the average
133   */
134  @Nullable
135  public static IAnyAtomicItem min(@NonNull List<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> items) {
136    // FIXME: support implicit timezone
137    return normalize(items)
138        .reduce(null, (item1, item2) -> {
139          // FIXME: figure out a better way to handle implicit namespaces
140          return item1 != null && ComparisonFunctions.valueCompairison(
141              item1,
142              ComparisonFunctions.Operator.LE,
143              ObjectUtils.notNull(item2),
144              new DynamicContext()).toBoolean()
145                  ? item1
146                  : item2;
147        });
148  }
149
150  /**
151   * An implementation of XPath 3.1
152   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-max">fn:max</a>.
153   *
154   * @param items
155   *          the items to find the maximum value for
156   * @return the average
157   */
158  @Nullable
159  public static IAnyAtomicItem max(@NonNull List<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> items) {
160    // FIXME: support implicit timezone
161    return normalize(items)
162        .reduce(null, (item1, item2) -> {
163          // FIXME: figure out a better way to handle implicit namespaces
164          return item1 != null && ComparisonFunctions.valueCompairison(
165              item1,
166              ComparisonFunctions.Operator.GE,
167              ObjectUtils.notNull(item2),
168              new DynamicContext()).toBoolean()
169                  ? item1
170                  : item2;
171        });
172  }
173
174  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.OnlyOneReturn") // readability
175  private static Stream<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> normalize(
176      @NonNull List<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> items) {
177    if (items.isEmpty()) {
178      return Stream.empty();
179    }
180
181    if (items.size() == 1) {
182      return Stream.of(items.get(0));
183    }
184
185    List<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> resultingItems = convertUntypedItems(items);
186    Map<Class<? extends IAnyAtomicItem>, Integer> counts = countItemTypes(resultingItems);
187    return createNormalizedStream(resultingItems, counts);
188  }
189
190  @NonNull
191  private static List<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> convertUntypedItems(
192      @NonNull List<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> items) {
193    return ObjectUtils.notNull(items.stream()
194        .map(item -> item instanceof IUntypedAtomicItem ? IDecimalItem.cast(item) : item)
195        .collect(Collectors.toList()));
196  }
197
198  @NonNull
199  private static Map<Class<? extends IAnyAtomicItem>, Integer> countItemTypes(
200      @NonNull List<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> items) {
201    return FunctionUtils.countTypes(PRIMITIVE_ITEM_TYPES, items);
202  }
203
204  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.OnlyOneReturn")
205  @NonNull
206  private static Stream<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> createNormalizedStream(
207      @NonNull List<? extends IAnyAtomicItem> items,
208      @NonNull Map<Class<? extends IAnyAtomicItem>, Integer> counts) {
209
210    // Single type - no conversion needed
211    if (counts.size() == 1) {
212      return ObjectUtils.notNull(items.stream());
213    }
214
215    // Multiple types - attempt conversion
216    int size = items.size();
217    if (counts.size() > 1) {
218      // Check if all items are either String or AnyUri
219      if (counts.getOrDefault(IStringItem.class, 0) + counts.getOrDefault(IAnyUriItem.class, 0) == size) {
220        return ObjectUtils.notNull(items.stream().map(IAnyAtomicItem::asStringItem));
221      }
222
223      // Check if all items are Decimal
224      if (counts.getOrDefault(IDecimalItem.class, 0) == size) {
225        return ObjectUtils.notNull(items.stream().map(item -> (IDecimalItem) item));
226      }
227    }
228
229    // No valid conversion possible
230    throw new InvalidArgumentFunctionException(
231        InvalidArgumentFunctionException.INVALID_ARGUMENT_TYPE,
232        String.format(
233            "Values must all be of a single atomic type. Found multiple types: [%s]",
234            FunctionUtils.getTypes(items).stream()
235                .map(Class::getSimpleName)
236                .collect(Collectors.joining(", "))));
237  }
238}
